description: This file defines custom loss functions and auxiliary functions for object detection training using YOLO architecture. It includes bounding box IOU calculations, a main compute_loss function that aggregates bounding box, objectness, and class losses, and helper functions to build detection targets.

methods.name: bbox_iou(box1, box2, x1y1x2y2=True, GIoU=False, DIoU=False, CIoU=False, eps=1e-9)
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) or variants like GIoU, DIoU, CIoU between two bounding boxes.

methods.name: compute_loss(loss_layers, targets, device="cpu")
methods.description: Calculates combined loss for object detection, including bounding box regression loss, objectness loss, and classification loss, for a set of prediction layers.

methods.name: build_targets(p, targets, loss_layers, device="cpu")
methods.description: Builds target tensors for training based on ground truth targets and model predictions, mapping them to appropriate grid cells and anchors.
